observed.interrupt_produces_state: After a run that hits interrupt(), GET /threads/{id}/state returns interrupts list non-empty and values/interrupts projected
observed.resume: POST /threads/{id}/runs/stream with command: {resume: {accept: False}} or {accept: true, fields: [...] } maps to graph Command(resume=...)

replay.description: Second identical resume after first completed should be idempotent: either 409 or state values unchanged
replay.note: OSS RunEngine must enforce at-least-once deduplication or surface 409 for duplicate command; both satisfy oracle observation

observed.invalid_resume: malformed command → 4xx (422 or 400) per fixture; executor must not crash
observed.concurrent_run_rejected: Second concurrent run on same thread with multitask_strategy reject → 409

assertions_for_oss: Interrupt after first turn is observable via state interrupts
Resume with command resumes and produces new state
Identical replay is idempotent (409 or same values)
